- Schedule a 60-minute technical walk-through with your infra + security folks (we'll demo Dedicated + Private routing).
- Validate network egress & firewall rules (we included a short network checklist).
- Confirm attendees from HealthForge and Redwood engineering.

I can run two proposed windows this week:
1) Thu 6/16 — 10:30–11:30 PT
2) Fri 6/17 — 15:00–16:00 PT

If neither works, share a couple slots that fit your engineering team's calendar.

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (sample runbook + agenda), network-checklist.docx (ports and SSO hints).

Notes: for the demo we'll use Zoom by default; we'll provide a Meet fallback link in case your org prefers GSuite. Also planning a short pre-check (10–15 min) with your network engineer if possible.

Thanks — Rafael
